headline: 4 warehouses of Salman Muqtadir’s father-in-law sealed in Gulshan
summary: The Department of Narcotics Control (DNC) took action against Sheikh Nur Islam for storing duty-free alcohol without proper documentation.
details: The Department of Narcotics Control (DNC) has sealed four warehouses in Gulshan, Dhaka, belonging to Sheikh Nur Islam, the father-in-law of content creator Salman Muqtadir.
The operation was conducted last night as part of a broader anti-drug drive. Officials found duty-free alcohol imported under bond facilities stored in the warehouses.
DNC Director General Mohammad Hasan Maruf stated that discrepancies were found between the actual stock and the records in the registers and software.
During the raid, officials recovered 144 cans of beer along with other alcohol, which had been marked as released in the software but were still physically present in the warehouse.
caption:
4 warehouses sealed in Gulshan! The DNC raids the father-in-law of content creator Salman Muqtadir over duty-free alcohol discrepancies.

The Department of Narcotics Control (DNC) has sealed four warehouses in Gulshan, Dhaka, belonging to Sheikh Nur Islam, the father-in-law of content creator Salman Muqtadir.

The operation was conducted last night as part of a broader anti-drug drive. Officials found duty-free alcohol imported under bond facilities stored in the warehouses.

DNC Director General Mohammad Hasan Maruf stated that discrepancies were found between the actual stock and the records in the registers and software.

During the raid, officials recovered 144 cans of beer along with other alcohol, which had been marked as released in the software but were still physically present in the warehouse.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com

headline_marked: Jamaat leader [[Akhtaruzzaman sued over airport assault]] and disorder
headline: Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman sued over airport assault and disorder
summary: The former lawmaker is accused of threatening the airport's executive director and assaulting a security supervisor following luggage delays.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami leader Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman has been sued following allegations of creating disorder and assaulting officials at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
The case was filed on Friday by airport security officer Md. Shahriar Alam Sajib, following an incident that occurred on Thursday.
According to the FIR, passengers on a Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight from Medina became dissatisfied due to delays in receiving their luggage.
When the airport's executive director, Group Captain SM Raghib Samad, arrived to control the situation, Akhtaruzzaman allegedly misbehaved and threatened him with assault.
The leader is further accused of physically assaulting security supervisor Warrant Officer Mohammad Kamal Uddin after being stopped from filming in a restricted area.
Additionally, the FIR alleges that he threw Zamzam water bottles at other passengers and behaved aggressively toward a Biman Bangladesh representative.
The case has been filed under several sections of the Penal Code, and an investigation is underway based on CCTV footage and witness statements.
Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman is a former MP for the Kishoreganj-2 constituency and officially joined Jamaat-e-Islami in December 2025 after being expelled from the BNP.
caption:
A former lawmaker and Jamaat leader is in legal trouble after an airport luggage delay sparked a chaotic scene.

Jamaat-e-Islami leader Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman has been sued following allegations of creating disorder and assaulting officials at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.

The case was filed on Friday by airport security officer Md. Shahriar Alam Sajib, following an incident that occurred on Thursday.

According to the FIR, passengers on a Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight from Medina became dissatisfied due to delays in receiving their luggage.

When the airport's executive director, Group Captain SM Raghib Samad, arrived to control the situation, Akhtaruzzaman allegedly misbehaved and threatened him with assault.

The leader is further accused of physically assaulting security supervisor Warrant Officer Mohammad Kamal Uddin after being stopped from filming in a restricted area.

Additionally, the FIR alleges that he threw Zamzam water bottles at other passengers and behaved aggressively toward a Biman Bangladesh representative.

The case has been filed under several sections of the Penal Code, and an investigation is underway based on CCTV footage and witness statements.

Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman is a former MP for the Kishoreganj-2 constituency and officially joined Jamaat-e-Islami in December 2025 after being expelled from the BNP.
